entities.summary: Jago temple is a 13th-century Hindu-Buddhist temple from the Singhasari kingdom in East Java, Indonesia, located about 22 kilometres (14 mi) from Malang. The Nagarakretagama, written in 14th century, describes this temple as Jajaghu, and mentions it as one of the temples visited by King Hayam Wuruk during his royal tour across East Java. It is one of several similar temples in the region.
